venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.weather: It was so historically cold I wore long Johns while serving
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Sunday 2/8.** Super Bowl Sunday plus historically cold weather: historically slow, slower than any day in the writer's tenure; staffing cut and service workers cut early came in. Dead until 11, then a short-lived pop. Kyler correctly predicted exactly 57 covers in a staff betting pool. Comps $26.40. Top sellers: Grand Entrance, Material Control, Don Fulano Anejo (tied). Door: extreme cold warning, many cancellations, very few walk-ins; Max's first night fully live. 2 no-shows, 1 cancellation (Stephanie Grube). Kitchen: lack of food options crimped a few tables.
